description: Hand-labelled claim/source pairs for measuring the Critic (Unit 6 feedback #2). Sources are the recorded API fixtures in tests/fixtures. 'supported' is the positive class. Unsupported claims cover the typical hallucination types: over-generalisation, wrong entity, fabricated number, metric shift, contradiction and fabricated contribution.
